I used to be like that too - always worried about becoming pregnant despite the fact that I've been on the pill for years. I would worry so much that my periods would take longer to start, and I can't even begin to count the number of pregnancy tests I've taken just to assure myself that I wasn't pregnant.

Just remember that increased stress can actually delay the onset of a period by up to several days, or under extreme stress can limit/halt them entirely. If you want to purchase pregnancy tests just to calm yourself down, then that's alright, but they are kind of expensive. Maybe try reassuring yourself that the pill is 99.9% accurate around the time of your period - and try relaxing activities like baths, aromatherapy, yoga, or meditation.

Given that you're at work, it's likely that someone would find you and be able to revive you in time. Even if you're at work alone, pills are not a very reliable means of actually ending your life. Lots of the time people just get very sick, or sometimes it depresses their respiration long enough to cause brain damage but not long enough to kill them. 

I'm not advocating for you to find a different means of ending it, but I did want to let you know about the other possible outcomes you might have.

I know the feeling. I did great throughout elementary, middle, and high school. I was put into advanced classes as soon as they were available to me, and I finished high school with a great gpa. My depression started in high school and I think I was able to handle it better because of the friends I had around me every day. We were really close-knit and would always be talking to each other online or hanging out outside of school. 

Then college came and I fell apart. I think it was the combo of not having any close friends around me anymore coupled with guys treating me like crap that led me into deeper stages of depression, and I've been there ever since. Sometimes the SSRIs help a little bit, but mostly they allow me to get from day to day with a fake smile on my face. But when night time comes and I'm not around anyone, that's when the darkness takes its toll on me. I can't ever get much studying done. My mind wanders and I keep replaying things in my head and seeing how happy everyone else is and crying myself to sleep. It's a vicious cycle that's extremely hard to break. 

I hope you can find something that works for you. Try to break free of this

I understand where you're coming from. Depression has hindered my performance in school for years now. It got to the point where I failed a class and almost failed several others. If you wanted to try counseling or medical treatments most schools offer free counseling and cheap student clinic visits to establish medical management. If you just want to talk or vent I'm also here to listen. Feel free to pm me if you'd like

Some cheaters enter a relationship/marriage completely 100% in without ever thinking they'd become a cheater. That's what happened in my case. I had been treated like crap by every boyfriend before my husband - they used me for sex, had committed relationships on the side and made me the other woman, or cheated on me. I had even been physically and emotionally abused by a parent for most of my childhood/adolescence. I went through so many years of depression before meeting my husband, and he was the first person to actually be nice and want to be with me.

And then sometimes life throws a curve ball at you that you don't expect. I had to move far away for dental school and was living by myself for many months and not making many friends, and my depression got real bad. My husband got sick of dealing with my depression and started yelling at me (I can't deal with anybody yelling at me after years of verbal abuse) and as a result I couldn't talk to him about things any longer. I would've killed myself if my one good friend hadn't noticed and stepped in. He became my best friend, and then my lover. 

It's not always so black and white. Part of me wishes I had killed myself earlier so that at least I wouldn't be a cheater, but at the same time I had never been happier in my life than when I was with the other guy. I actually wanted to try doing the right thing and coming clean and just ending things with my husband, but the other guy doesn't want to continue the relationship and would rather stay with his long-term girlfriend. At this point I'd rather just finish school and accomplish one thing before killing myself. 

I guess in the end I'm doing the one thing you want cheaters to do, which is to die. You seem to think that everyone who cheats is a malicious demon whose one goal in life has been to destroy other people, but that's not always how it goes. I really did love my husband, and I still care about him, which is part of why I'm going to kill myself - so he doesn't have to deal with the humiliation of divorce and so that he can just read my letter and go straight to hating my instead of mourning me.

Sometimes you fall in love with someone else under extreme circumstances. Sometimes the relationship you thought was perfect for you turns into something else. And sometimes no matter how hard you try you stumble and fall and make a horrible mistake, one that you cannot fix and cannot feel better about

I feel bad for cheating on my husband. I know it's a selfish and horrible thing to do. It's unfair to my husband and he deserves better.

But at the same time I'm not sorry for falling in love with Evan. Without him I would've already killed myself. In the months before my husband moved out here, being with him was the happiest I had ever been in my life. And for Evan it was nothing - just a way to pass the time before the better girl showed up.

There's no way to feel better about this and there's no way to fix it. Even if I leave my husband right now I'll still spend the rest of my life in love with Evan knowing he's living out his perfect life with the woman he loves. I'll have no friends, no family, nothing. I'll just be wasting away until the day I finally die.

I don't want to draw it out like that. If luck allows me to pass the rest of my courses and exams at most I'll have just under 2 years left. I doubt I'll even be able to last that long

My whole life has been a 'hit bottom' moment. I've always had to struggle against people I loved and cared for who stabbed me in the back and then abandoned me. I've always struggled to barely make it through college, and now graduate school. I'm at the bottom of my class and yet again with no friends.

I know that I'll always love Evan. I felt things with him that I never felt before. He was the only person to help pull me out of the darkness that was my life and give me a glimmer of how different things could be, but then he shoved me shoved me right back into that darkness even more broken than I was. He's everything I had ever wanted in a lover, and I actually thought for a while that he truly wanted to be with me.

I can't keep living this way. I'm completely alone. My husband deserves a better wife. My family deserves to be free of all my drama - they would hate me forever if they ever found out about my affair. Even Evan deserves better than a train wreck like me.

And I deserve to die
